# RAG Requirements Checklist: Institutional Assistant

**Purpose**: Validate that the feature requirements are complete, clear, consistent, and ready for planning without testing implementation behavior.
**Created**: 2026-06-30
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are all P1 user stories mapped to explicit functional requirements? [Completeness, Spec §User Scenarios, Spec §Functional Requirements]
- [ ] CHK002 Are all administrator capabilities covered by requirements for source configuration, update execution, rebuild, and index status? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011, Spec §FR-015, Spec §FR-018, Spec §FR-019]
- [ ] CHK003 Are requirements defined for both complete re-indexing and administrator-selected incremental updates? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK004 Are source metadata requirements complete for answer citation, filtering, freshness, and regional coverage? [Completeness, Spec §Institutional Source Requirements]
- [ ] CHK005 Are requirements for public local query access and protected administrator actions both documented? [Completeness, Spec §FR-025, Spec §FR-026]
- [ ] CHK006 Are out-of-scope items complete enough to prevent accidental inclusion of login, PDFs, web UI, conversation history, or automatic change detection? [Completeness, Spec §Out of Scope]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 Is the approved insufficient-context refusal text specified exactly and consistently? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, Spec §Institutional Source Requirements]
- [ ] CHK008 Is "global relevance threshold" defined clearly enough to avoid area-specific threshold assumptions in the initial version? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006, Spec §Relevance Threshold Policy]
- [ ] CHK009 Is "incremental update" clarified as re-processing administrator-selected configured sources? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK010 Is user-visible source display defined as URL plus page title when available, without requiring exact fragments? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005, Spec §User-Visible Source Display]
- [ ] CHK011 Is the initial regional scope clear as rectorado plus configured regionales or departments per installation? [Clarity, Spec §FR-027, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK012 Are "clear structured errors" specific enough to guide planning for unavailable response generation, empty index, and not-ready index states? [Clarity, Spec §FR-021, Spec §User Story 5]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK013 Are access requirements consistent with the out-of-scope exclusion of end-user login? [Consistency, Spec §FR-025, Spec §FR-026, Spec §Out of Scope]
- [ ] CHK014 Are filtering requirements consistent with configured institutional areas and optional user selection? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009, Spec §FR-010, Spec §Institutional Areas]
- [ ] CHK015 Are citation requirements consistent across user story acceptance criteria, functional requirements, source metadata, and success criteria? [Consistency, Spec §User Story 3, Spec §FR-005, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK016 Are update failure requirements consistent between acceptance scenarios and the requirement to preserve the previous usable index? [Consistency, Spec §User Story 4, Spec §FR-016, Spec §SC-006]
- [ ] CHK017 Are local-only and no-paid-service boundaries consistently represented in assumptions and out-of-scope statements? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions, Spec §Out of Scope]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK018 Are all acceptance scenarios independently testable from the written requirements without needing implementation details? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §User Scenarios]
- [ ] CHK019 Are success criteria quantified for answer relevance, citation presence, refusal behavior, response timing, update reporting, index preservation, corpus size, and source discoverability? [Measurability, Spec §Success Criteria]
- [ ] CHK020 Can the 90% representative FAQ target be evaluated from a defined acceptance dataset or is that dataset still a planning gap? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK021 Is the "normal local conditions" qualifier precise enough for evaluating the 5-second user response target? [Ambiguity, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK022 Is the 50,000-fragment corpus target tied to an expected query experience that can be objectively evaluated? [Measurability, Spec §SC-007]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK023 Are primary query, refusal, citation, update, error, filtering, and index-status flows all represented by user stories? [Coverage, Spec §User Scenarios]
- [ ] CHK024 Are alternate flows covered for no area filter, selected area filter, insufficient area-specific content, and configured multi-regional installations? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 6, Spec §FR-027]
- [ ] CHK025 Are recovery flows documented for failed updates, failed individual sources, unavailable response generation, and not-ready index states? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 4, Spec §User Story 5, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK026 Are administrative observability needs specified beyond counts, dates, covered areas, and recent failures, or intentionally limited to those fields? [Coverage, Spec §FR-018, Spec §User Story 7]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK027 Are validation edge cases specified for empty questions and over-limit questions with clear outcomes? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK028 Are source extraction edge cases specified for empty pages, script-only pages, failed URLs, and useless content? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §FR-012, Spec §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK029 Are concurrency expectations specified for queries during an index update? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK030 Are missing local resource scenarios specified with clear user/admin-facing outcomes? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK031 Are timeout expectations specified clearly enough for planning controlled errors without leaking internal details? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §User Story 5]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK032 Are performance targets expressed in user-observable terms and free of implementation-specific leakage? [Non-Functional, Spec §SC-004, Spec §SC-007]
- [ ] CHK033 Are reliability requirements documented for unsupported answers, failed source updates, and preservation of the previous index? [Non-Functional, Spec §FR-006, Spec §FR-016, Spec §SC-006]
- [ ] CHK034 Are privacy/autonomy boundaries specified for local deployment and exclusion of paid external core services? [Non-Functional, Spec §Out of Scope]
- [ ] CHK035 Are maintainability requirements specified through configurability of sources, limits, thresholds, area definitions, chunk sizing, and model choices? [Non-Functional, Spec §FR-022]
- [ ] CHK036 Are localization requirements specific enough for Argentinian Spanish and university vocabulary? [Non-Functional, Spec §FR-001, Spec §FR-004, Spec §User Story 1]

## Constitution Compliance

- [ ] CHK037 Does every requirement and user story avoid authorizing code before validated planning and tasks exist? [Constitution, Spec §Input, Spec §Out of Scope]
- [ ] CHK038 Are requirements traceable enough to prevent unbacked scraper, processor, vectorstore, RAG, API, or admin components? [Constitution, Spec §FR-024]
- [ ] CHK039 Are business-rule test obligations implied by requirements for refusal, citation, update failure, source errors, and threshold behavior? [Constitution, Spec §FR-006, Spec §FR-014, Spec §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK040 Are closed-value domains for source type, institutional area, and regional/department metadata sufficiently specified for later typed modeling? [Constitution, Spec §Institutional Source Requirements, Spec §Key Entities]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK041 Are assumptions about HTML-only sources, no internal systems, no PDFs, and no web UI consistent with all user stories? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions, Spec §Out of Scope]
- [ ] CHK042 Are assumptions about source inclusion/exclusion lists specific enough to guide planning of ephemeral news and past events? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK043 Are dependencies on configured public UTN sources documented without requiring a fixed list before planning? [Dependency, Spec §FR-011, Spec §Assumptions]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK044 Is the initial numeric relevance threshold intentionally deferred to planning without blocking requirements validation? [Ambiguity, Spec §Relevance Threshold Policy]
- [ ] CHK045 Is the exact method of protecting administrator actions intentionally deferred without conflicting with the no-login initial scope? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-026, Spec §Out of Scope]
- [ ] CHK046 Is the definition of "representative institutional FAQ questions" clear enough for planning, or should the spec require a curated acceptance set? [Ambiguity, Spec §SC-001]

## Notes

- This checklist validates requirement writing quality only.
- Items should be checked before `/speckit-plan` when the spec text itself satisfies the question.
- Items that remain unchecked should become clarifications or explicit planning inputs, not implementation tasks yet.
